moved.sentence: Use Dynamic Type throughout — avoid fixed font sizes.

judged.note: Rule should-use-dynamic-type-throughout keeps the unkeyed instruction at SHOULD with both halves: use Dynamic Type throughout and avoid fixed font sizes.

moved.sentence: Custom fonts must respond to the bold text accessibility setting.

judged.note: Rule must-make-custom-fonts-respond-to-bold-text raises the lowercase 'must' to MUST and keeps the scope (custom fonts) and the trigger (the bold text accessibility setting).
